gz.name: Guangzhou
gz.tagline: Old Canton by dawn, the river by night

days.title: Land in Guangzhou
days.move: Baiyun Airport → city on Metro Line 3, about 45 min. Base near Haizhu Square or Beijing Road, 10 min from Liwan and Dongshan.
seed: An easy first walk along the river to the bridge.

days.title: Shamian at dawn, the river by night
Qilou arcades and Gothic spires
seed: Dim sum at Taotaoju (陶陶居) on the way back.

days.title: Old Xiguan, red-brick Dongshan
seed: Dinner in one of the villa restaurants.

days.title: Carvings, then Shenzhen Bay
days.move: Guangzhou South → Futian, about 40 min. A late-morning train leaves the afternoon for Shenzhen. Stay in Futian.
seed: Leave by about 10:15 for the station.

days.title: Old walls and the CBD axis
Across to Hong Kong
days.move: Futian → West Kowloon, about 15 min. Both border checks happen on arrival at West Kowloon. Take a 07:30 train to be working by 09:00.

days.title: Incense and escalators
seed: Then ride the escalator up into work.

days.title: Trams, Lamma, the last sunset
seed: Ferry back to Central by about 16:00.

days.title: Train to Baiyun, fly home
days.move: West Kowloon → Guangzhou East (92–108 min), then Metro Line 3 to Baiyun Airport, about 45 min. Hong Kong exit and mainland entry happen at West Kowloon before boarding. Leave the hotel about 6 hours before the flight.

logistics.title: Trains
body: Futian → West Kowloon: about 15 min. Both border checks happen on arrival at West Kowloon.
West Kowloon → Guangzhou East: 92–108 min, then Metro Line 3 to Baiyun Airport, about 45 min.

logistics.title: Light, late November
body: Sunrise about 06:45, sunset about 17:40 in all three cities.
Blue hour runs roughly 17:45–18:15, right at the end of the working day. Weekday shooting is dawn or night.

logistics.title: Entry
body: Many passports get visa-free entry to mainland China for up to 30 days. This route enters the mainland twice.
Hong Kong visa-free stays depend on nationality. Check both before booking.

logistics.title: Connectivity
body: Mainland internet is filtered. A roaming eSIM routes outside it; keep a VPN as backup on hotel Wi-Fi.

logistics.title: Money and weather
body: Set up Alipay and WeChat Pay with a foreign card before landing. Cash and cards barely work on the mainland.
Late November is dry and mild, roughly 15–24°C.

logistics.title: Maps
body: On the mainland, search Apple Maps or Amap with the Chinese name, since Google Maps is blocked. Every spot card has a copy button for it.

brief.text: Two weeks in the Pearl River Delta around a 9-to-6 remote job. I love street and night photography, neon, old architecture, big skylines and long exposures over the water. Weekends are free. I'd rather not do long hikes.
